operations.description: Returns a list of xrefs and associated attributes that contain the query string for a given organism. Results are not restricted to exact matches. Optionally limit results to a specified number per data source, or by the type of attribute. See possible attribute types via /{organism}/attributeSet.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] attribute search [PARAMS] attr limit name organism query [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns the supported attributes to the given Organism.
Returns the attributes for a given identifier, data source, organism. Optionally display only a specified attribute
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] attributes [PARAMS] attr code identifier name organism system [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns `true` or `false` based on whether or not /{organism}/search/{query} is supported for a given organism.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] is free search supported [PARAMS] organism [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns `true` or `false` based on whether or not /{organism}/xrefs/{systemCode}/{identifier} would possibly return a {targetSystemCode} result given a {sourceSystemCode} query. This function basically combines the results of /{organism}/sourceDataSources and /{organism}/targetDataSources into a single boolean result.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] is mapping supported [PARAMS] code organism source system target [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns the list of properties available for a given organism

Returns a list of xrefs with identifiers that contain the query string for a given organism. Results are not restricted to exact matches. Optionally limit results to a specified number per data source.
Returns a list of data sources available as xref sources for a given organism.
Returns a list of data sources available as xref targets for a given organism.
Returns `true` or `false` based on whether or not an xref exists in the database given an identifier, data source, and organism.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] xref exists [PARAMS] code identifier organism system [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of xrefs that map to a given identifier, data source, and organism.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] xrefs [PARAMS] code data identifier organism source system [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of xrefs, per identifier, that maps to a given list of identifiers an data source given an organism.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] xrefs batch [PARAMS] data organism source [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of xrefs, that maps to a given list of identifiers to a given data source and organism.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] xrefs batch [PARAMS] code data organism source system [SCHEMA]
